question: Test whether binary parity and hard-gate receipts identify the C06 staged transfer fractions.

objects.definition: Three matching closure bits in the selected direct flip context
Direct share of source stock and matching share of retained pair-even source stock

sources.section_or_object_id: Exact continuous response and finite-step candidate

assumptions: Closed Euclidean source/direct/matching registers with fixed real orthogonal stages.
Fixed supplied binary event and integrity histories; their interface imposes no stage-amplitude linkage.
Countermodels are algebraic completions of that interface. Quantitative receipt guards are an agile hypothesis.

technique_plan.technique: finite parity enumeration and rational norm budgets
technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: separate identical binary histories from different conservative gain responses

integer_fraction_receipt.raw_count_expression: 8 initial states × 6 pair permutations × 8 supplied flips × 64 integrity masks

clock_receipt.clock_type: ordered stages; ideal dimensionless oscillator for candidate guard

dynamics_readout.state_space: real Euclidean source and record registers plus independent finite typed receipts
dynamics_readout.conservation_and_sources: total squared norm conserved in each sector; binary gates fixed by supplied event inputs

target_exposure.search_domain_and_budget: exact receipt enumeration and four rational witnesses; no empirical fit

calculation_steps: Hold binary receipt inputs fixed and vary norm-preserving completions
Distinguish signed amplitude and squared-stock trigger at depletion

result.exact_expression: eta=f/(1-f), 0<f<=1/2; same binary receipts allow ratios 2,4,3/2
result.scope: Same binary receipts and conserved norm admit unequal gain ratios. Positive equality requires eta=f/(1-f); full transfer imposes f=1/2 only under the selected two-stage model.

counterexamples_and_failures: Half/full not necessary for isotropy when partial transfer is admitted
Unsigned exact-zero guard is tangential in the ideal oscillator
limitations: Insufficiency scoped to declared interface; no physical Pachner event validated
No native quantitative trigger or deficit allocation
next_discriminant: Derive an independently sourced quantitative pre-event transfer receipt, then test locality, observability and robustness at the balance and depletion guards.
